env KCLI_CONFIG_HOME=$WORK/config

env KCLI_STATE_HOME=$WORK/state

env KCLI_CACHE_HOME=$WORK/cache

exec kcli version
stdout '"schema": "kcli.version/v1"'
! stderr .

exec kcli schema list
stdout '"path": "search"'
stdout '"path": "dm reply"'
! stderr .

exec kcli schema show search
stdout '"title": "SearchInputV1"'
stdout '"side_effect": "none"'
! stderr .

exec kcli config list
stdout '"source": "default"'
! stderr .

exec kcli config set output json
stdout '"schema": "kcli.config-change/v1"'
! stderr .

exec kcli config get output
stdout '"value": "json"'
stdout '"source": "profile:default"'
! stderr .

exec kcli config path
stdout 'config.json'
! stderr .

exec kcli completion bash
stdout '^complete '
! stderr .

exec kcli doctor
stdout '"schema": "kcli.doctor/v1"'
stdout '"name": "state"'
stdout '"name": "network"'
! stderr .

! exec kcli search x
stdout '"schema": "kcli.error/v1"'
stdout '"code": "unavailable"'
stderr '^search state is unavailable$'
